newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Varig to unveil expansion plan - paper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Varig to unveil expansion plan - paper.

text.p: Brazil's national airline Varig is due to unveil a new image and expansion plans in an effort to return to profitability after first-half losses of around 150 million reais ($150 million), a newspaper said.

The airline hopes adding a dash of yellow to its blue and white "rose of the winds" logo -- and greater comfort and better service on its aircraft -- will help to improve its balance sheet, Gazeta Mercantil said.
"We'll take a large turn between 1996 and 1997, return to strong growth and become a heavyweight employer," Varig President Fernando Pinto was quoted as saying by Gazeta Mercantil.

Varig is investing $40 million to boost its image, $16 million of which will go towards redesigning the interior of its long haul aircraft, Gazeta said. The airline's executive class will become more spacious and offer passengers individual videos systems with a choice of 10 movies.
The company will also lease two new McDonnell Douglas Corp MD-11's and two new Boeing Co 727-200 aircraft by April next year.
Varig has scheduled a press conference later today to unveil its new image.
-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151
